title: Not the quality LauraAshley was known for
text: Not the quality LauraAshley was known for. Was excited to get these sheets for the winter but the quality came far below my expectations. Washed and dried them twice so far. Not soft, and I can see through the threads. I thought at least 180 thread count but definitely inferior. Not worth the money…

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley Home - Flannel Collection - Sheet Set - 100% Cotton, Ultra-Soft Brushed Flannel, Pre-Shrunk & Anti-Pill, Machine Washable Easy Care, King, Le Fleur
features: MATERIAL: Made from 100% Cotton Flannel; natural and breathable for maximum comfort

TOUCH & STYLE: Made using an 8-level brushing finish, provides an ultra-soft and cozy feel. The Laura Ashley Le Fleur Flannel Sheet Set features a petite floral print in a fresh blue and yellow on white accented with sage green
MATTRESS FIT: Fitted sheet fully elastic- Premium elastic encased around all 4 sides to keep the fitted sheet in place; 15" fitted sheet pocket depth (13" for twin and 14" for sizes).
SET INCLUDES: King Fitted Sheet (1-Piece): 80"W X 78"L, King Flat Sheet (1-Piece): 102"W X 108"L, King Pillowcase (2-Pieces): 40"W X 20"L

WASH & FEATURE DETAILS: Machine wash warm with like colors and before first use, tumble dry low. Flannel sheets go through an 8-step brushing standard; The cotton yarns are woven, then brushed 3 times on the face and once on the back, the fabric is then colored and or printed and finished with 3 additional brush treatments on the face and 1 on the back; Flannel is known for it warming properties; Cotton is a natural breathable fiber
description: Add an extra layer of warmth to your bedding ensemble with a new flannel sheet set from Laura Ashley Home. The Le Fleur flannel sheet set features a petite floral print from the archive with a modern update in a fresh palette of blue and yellow on white with sage accents, still keeping its inherent cottage charm. Twin flannel sheet set includes: one flat sheet (96"x66"), one fitted sheet (39"x75") and one pillowcase (20"x30"). full flannel sheet set includes: one flat sheet (96"x81"), one fitted sheet (54"x75") and two pillowcases (20"x30"). queen flannel sheet set includes: one flat sheet (102"x90"), one fitted sheet (60"x80") and two pillowcases (20"x30"). King flannel sheet set includes: one flat sheet (102"x108"), one fitted sheet (78"x80") and two pillowcases (20"x40").
